item.title: Lee: "Core Industry Investments Must Benefit Both Capital Region and Provinces" (李 “핵심산업 투자, 수도권·지방 윈윈해야”)
item.description:
Lee: "Core Industry Investments Must Benefit Both Capital Region and Provinces" (李 “핵심산업 투자, 수도권·지방 윈윈해야” )

President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 25th, "To overcome the single-pole system centered on the capital region, it is essential to implement a groundbreaking multi-polarization strategy for key industries, expanding large-scale investments in advanced core industries to regions such as Yeongnam, Chungcheong, Gangwon, Jeju, and Honam." This appears to refer to investments like semiconductor projects in Honam. (이재명 대통령은 25일 “수도권 일극 체제 극복을 위해 첨단 핵심 산업에 대한 대규모 투자를 영남이나 충청, 강원, 제주, 호남 등으로 확대하는 획기적인 전략 산업 다극화가 필수적”이라고 밝혔다. 호남 반도체 투자 등을 의미하는 것으로 보인다.)

President Lee made these remarks while chairing a meeting of senior secretaries and aides at the presidential office, saying, "The phenomenal growth effects of some industries have not spread to the provinces, which account for 90% of the national territory, and from the perspective of national and balanced development, the gap in inequality could deepen significantly." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 수석·보좌관 회의를 주재하며 “일부 산업의 경이적인 성장 효과가 국토의 90%를 차지하는 지방까지는 확산하지를 못해서, 국토 발전, 균형 발전이라는 측면에서는 불균등의 골이 훨씬 심화될 수 있다”며 이같이 말했다.)

President Lee added, "If we fail to overcome the single-pole system of the capital region, the good typhoon of change we are currently experiencing could fade into a momentary breeze, or in the worst case, transform into a storm of crisis beyond imagination. We must advance the core infrastructure of the capital region while simultaneously building new industrial and economic bases across the provinces, ensuring a win-win situation for both the capital region and the provinces, and ushering in an era of shared growth for all." (이 대통령은 “수도권 일극 체제를 극복하지 못하면 지금 우리가 경험하고 있는 이 좋은 변화의 태풍은 한순간의 미풍으로 그칠 수 있고, 자칫하면 상상조차 하기 어려운 위기의 폭풍으로 변할 수도 있다”며 “수도권의 핵심 인프라는 그것대로 고도화해 나가고, 동시에 지방 곳곳에 새로운 산업 경제 기반을 구축해 수도권과 지방이 함께 ‘윈윈’하는 모두의 성장 시대를 반드시 열어가야 한다”고 했다.)

President Lee further noted, "A detailed blueprint on this matter will be presented to the people soon." (이 대통령은 “이에 관한 구체적 청사진을 곧 국민 여러분께 보고드릴 예정”이라고 덧붙였다.)

item.title: PM Kim Says "Abolition of Prosecutors' Supplementary Investigation Rights Finalized as Government Position" (金총리 “檢 보완수사권 폐지, 정부 입장으로 최종 정리”)
item.description:
PM Kim Says "Abolition of Prosecutors' Supplementary Investigation Rights Finalized as Government Position" (金총리 “檢 보완수사권 폐지, 정부 입장으로 최종 정리”)

Prime Minister Kim Min-seok stated on the 25th that the government has finalized its position to completely abolish prosecutors' supplementary investigation rights without any exceptions. <<> PM Kim said in a press conference at the Government Complex Seoul that afternoon, "The fundamental principle of the prosecution reform pursued by the Lee Jae-myung administration is the separation of investigation and indictment." He added, "I have consistently stated my position that, based on this principle, prosecutors' supplementary investigation rights should be abolished." <<> PM Kim said, "Considering the various opinions discussed and gathered within the government, we have finalized the abolition of supplementary investigation rights as the government's basic position." <<> He added, "We will convey the government's basic position to the party, and afterward, rather than the government proposing a separate legislative bill, we will respect the discussions and decisions of the National Assembly." This means the government will not submit its own amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act to abolish supplementary investigation rights to the National Assembly. <<> The government had established a Prosecution Reform Promotion Team under the Prime Minister's Office to review whether to retain prosecutors' supplementary investigation rights, leave them exceptionally for certain cases, or completely abolish them and replace them with "rights to request supplementary investigations." The promotion team had planned to finalize the government's position and present a specific government bill to the National Assembly. Previously, the promotion team had submitted government bills for the establishment of an indictment agency and a serious crimes investigation agency to the National Assembly. <<> However, PM Kim said, "We judged that, while organizing the diverse views within the government, it would be more efficient and desirable not to submit a separate government bill to allow for free discussions in the National Assembly." <<> Regarding the earlier submission of the indictment agency and serious crimes investigation agency bills to the National Assembly, he explained, "Those were done after consultations with the party. For the second round of reforms (related to supplementary investigation rights), we judged it desirable to expedite the process faster than the initial party-government agreement and aimed for processing in May. We proposed this to the party, but it was postponed at the party's request." <<> ◇Full text of PM Kim Min-seok's announcement <<> Respected citizens, and members of the press, I will speak regarding the government's direction on prosecution reform. <<> The fundamental principle of the prosecution reform pursued by the Lee Jae-myung administration is the separation of investigation and indictment. This is a core principle of reform aimed at more reasonably restructuring the powers of the prosecution and more robustly protecting the basic rights of the people. I have consistently stated my position that, based on this principle, prosecutors' supplementary investigation rights should be abolished. <<> And, considering the various opinions discussed and gathered within the government, we have finalized the abolition of supplementary investigation rights as the government's basic position. <<> Accordingly, we will convey the government's basic position to the party, and afterward, rather than the government proposing a separate legislative bill, we will respect the discussions and decisions of the National Assembly. This is because we judged it desirable for the specific institutional design and legislation to be decided through sufficient discussion and deliberation in the National Assembly, the representative body of the people. Once legislation is enacted in the National Assembly, the government will faithfully implement the necessary follow-up measures in accordance with that decision. <<> Prosecution reform is not simply a matter of specific institutions or powers; it is a process of creating a judicial system for the people. Above all, I believe it is important to respect the will of the people and the discussions of the National Assembly. I look forward to various opinions being fully discussed in the National Assembly moving forward, leading to a reasonable conclusion based on the public sentiment. Thank you. <<> So far, this has been the full text of the announcement regarding the government's position on prosecution reform. I will add one more very brief explanation for clarity. <<> There was a party-government agreement to implement prosecution reform in two phases. This was an agreement made when Senior Presidential Secretary for Political Affairs Woo Sang-ho was in office. According to that party-government agreement, the first reform package (i.e., the first preliminary legislative notice) was submitted following the content and schedule previously agreed upon with the party. Both the content and the timing of that first preliminary legislative notice submission were subject to consultations with the party. <<> While observing the processing of the first reform package, we judged it desirable to expedite the second reform package faster than the initial party-government agreement, aiming for processing in May. We proposed this to the party, but it was postponed at the party's request. <<> Now, we judged that it is more efficient and desirable, while organizing the diverse views within the government, not to submit a separate government bill to allow for free discussions in the National Assembly. That is the reason for not submitting a separate government bill. If necessary, we believe we can provide support during the National Assembly's discussions by referencing the various opinions the government has gathered so far. Thank you. (김민석 국무총리는 25일 검사의 보완 수사권을 예외를 두지 않고 완전히 폐지하는 것을 정부 입장으로 정리했다고 밝혔다.)

item.title: One Day After Discharge, Lawmakers Say "Resign Voluntarily"... Calls for a 'Vote of Confidence' Emerge (張 퇴원 하루만에 의원들 “자진 사퇴하라”...‘재신임 투표’ 주장도 나와)
item.description:
One Day After Discharge, Lawmakers Say "Resign Voluntarily"... Calls for a 'Vote of Confidence' Emerge (張 퇴원 하루만에 의원들 “자진 사퇴하라”...‘재신임 투표’ 주장도 나와)

A day after People Power Party (PPP) leader Jang Dong-hyuk was discharged from the hospital, on the 25th, demands for his resignation erupted again within the PPP. The previous day, Chairman Jang dismissed the issue of his own position, stating, "It's a matter for the party members to decide," and within the party, there were even claims that a 'vote of confidence' should be held for Chairman Jang. (국민의힘 장동혁 대표가 퇴원한 지 하루 만인 25일 국민의힘에선 당대표 사퇴 요구가 또다시 분출했다. 전날 장 대표가 “당원들이 결정할 문제”라며 자신의 거취 문제를 일축하자, 당내에선 장 대표에 대한 ‘재신임 투표’를 해야 한다는 주장까지 나왔다.)

The 'Alternative and Future' group, a core gathering of first and second-term lawmakers within the PPP, held a breakfast meeting that morning at the National Assembly Members' Office Building and agreed to "urge Chairman Jang to voluntarily resign for the sake of the party's future," according to Rep. Lee Seong-kwon, the group's secretary. Rep. Lee stated, "There can be no trust without faith; with a leadership that has lost trust, the party's future cannot be expected." (국민의힘 초·재선 중심 모임인 ‘대안과 미래’는 이날 오전 국회 의원회관에서 조찬 회동을 열고 “당의 미래를 위해 장 대표가 스스로 사퇴할 것을 촉구한다”고 의견을 모았다고 모임 간사인 이성권 의원이 밝혔다. 이 의원은 “무신불립(無信不立), 신뢰 잃은 리더십으로는 당의 미래를 기대할 수 없다”고 했다.)

Rep. Lee further urged, "I call on the elected supreme council members, including Supreme Council member Shin Dong-wook, to make a decision." Since Chairman Jang has clearly drawn a line against resignation calls, this was interpreted as a call for the entire leadership, including supreme council members, to resign collectively, dissolve the supreme council, and elect a new leadership through a party convention. (이 의원은 이어 “신동욱 최고위원을 비롯한 선출직 최고위원들의 결단을 촉구한다”고 했다. 장 대표는 사퇴론에 선을 분명히 그었으니, 최고위원 등 지도부가 총사퇴해 최고위를 해산하고 전당대회를 통해 새 지도부를 선출하자는 뜻으로 해석됐다.)

At the meeting that day, there were also reports of voices advocating for pushing a 'vote of confidence for the party leader' among all party members. However, it was said that no conclusion was reached as some lawmakers dissuaded, saying, "If we initiate a vote of confidence right now, it will place a heavy burden on floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik, who is gathering opinions to manage the situation." One senior lawmaker commented, "Pushing Chairman Jang too hard now could intensify internal strife. We need to manage the pace." (이날 모임에선 아예 전 당원을 대상으로 한 ‘당대표 재신임 투표’를 추진해야 한다는 목소리도 나온 것으로 전해졌다. 다만 일부 의원이 “지금 당장 재신임 투표를 띄우면 사태 수습을 위해 의견을 수렴 중인 정점식 원내대표에게 큰 부담이 될 것”이라고 만류하면서 결론을 내지는 않았다고 한다. 한 중진 의원은 “지금 장 대표를 몰아붙이면 내분이 격화할 가능성이 크다”며 “속도 조절이 필요하다”고 했다.)

Regarding Chairman Jang's re-emphasis on the previous day about the need for a 'by-election' in connection with the shortage of ballots for the June 3 local elections, the lawmakers' meeting stated, "It constitutes an act of insubordination for the party leader to reject a conclusion already reached at the general meeting of lawmakers." Earlier, on the 17th, the PPP had decided at a general meeting to pursue an election appeal only for areas where the ballot shortage was confirmed. Rep. Lee Seong-kwon said, "Let's convene a general meeting of lawmakers including the party leader and gather consensus again through a secret ballot," and requested floor leader Jeong, "Please ensure that the party leader no longer makes individual statements that plunge the party into chaos." (의원 모임은 장 대표가 전날 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태와 관련해 ‘재선거’ 필요성을 재차 강조한 것에 대해선 “이미 의원총회에서 결론이 난 것을 당 대표가 거부하는 건 해당 행위”라고 했다. 앞서 국민의힘은 지난 17일 의총에서 투표용지 부족 사태가 확인된 일부 지역에 한해서만 선거소청을 추진키로 했다. 이성권 의원은 “당 대표를 포함한 의총을 열고 비밀투표를 통해 총의를 (다시) 모으자”며 “당 대표가 더 이상 개인 의견을 발표해 당을 혼란에 빠뜨리지 않도록 해달라”고 정 원내대표에게 요청했다.)

At the supreme council meeting that day, which Chairman Jang chaired for the first time since returning to party duties, he urged an immediate acceptance of a special counsel regarding the ballot shortage, saying, "Rejecting a special counsel will be the fuse that sinks the administration." He made no comments on internal party issues, including his own position. A party insider remarked, "Since he has already made his stance clear on the resignation demands, this likely means he intends to focus on attacking the opposition." (장 대표는 당무 복귀 후 처음 주재한 이날 최고위원 회의에서 투표용지 부족 사태와 관련해 “특검 거부는 정권 침몰의 도화선이 될 것”이라며 즉각 특검을 수용하라고 촉구했다. 자신의 거취를 비롯한 당내 문제와 관련해선 발언하지 않았다. 야당 관계자는 “사퇴 요구에 대해선 이미 입장을 명확히 했으니 대여 공세에 집중하겠다는 뜻 아니겠냐”고 했다.)

item.title: People Power Party: "Abolition of Supplementary Investigation Powers—Rampaging with Only the 'Cult-like Hardcore Female Supporters' in Sight" (野 “보완수사권 폐지, ‘개딸’만 보고 폭주하는 것”)
item.description:
People Power Party: "Abolition of Supplementary Investigation Powers—Rampaging with Only the 'Cult-like Hardcore Female Supporters' in Sight" (野 “보완수사권 폐지, ‘개딸’만 보고 폭주하는 것”)

On the 25th, the People Power Party criticized Prime Minister Kim Min-seok's announcement of the government's official position to abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers, stating, "The Democratic Party, which is ramping up with only President Lee Jae-myung's hardcore supporters in sight, is ruining the country." <<> Choi Eun-seok, the chief deputy spokesperson of the People Power Party, said in a commentary that day, "Prime Minister Kim has formalized the government's policy to completely abolish the prosecutor's supplementary investigation powers without exception," adding, "Though I had a sliver of doubt, it ultimately ended in the most concerning direction." <<> Chief Deputy Spokesperson Choi stated, "President Lee Jae-myung mentioned the need for supplementary investigations in his 100-day press conference, saying, 'Just because you hate maggots, would you discard the entire soy sauce jar?'" He continued, "Nevertheless, Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae pushed for the complete abolition of supplementary investigation powers without exception, and Prime Minister Kim formalized that hardline stance as the government's final policy." <<> He then questioned, "Was President Lee's cautious approach ignored? Or was it just empty words from the start? item.title: Kim Eo-jun on Lee's Falling Approval Ratings: "Core Support Base Defecting... Performance Alone Won't Fix It" (김어준, 李 지지율 하락에 “코어 지지층 이탈…성과 낸다고 해결 안돼”)
item.description:
Kim Eo-jun on Lee's Falling Approval Ratings: "Core Support Base Defecting... Performance Alone Won't Fix It" (김어준, 李 지지율 하락에 “코어 지지층 이탈…성과 낸다고 해결 안돼”)

Pro-government YouTuber Kim Eo-jun pointed out on the 25th regarding President Lee Jae-myung's declining approval ratings, "Unlike typical declines, the 'core support base' is defecting." (친여 유튜버 김어준씨가 25일 이재명 대통령의 지지율 하락세를 놓고 “통상의 하락과 달리 ‘코어 지지층’이 이탈하고 있다”고 지적했다.)

On his YouTube broadcast that day, Kim said, "President Lee is a politician who has boosted his approval ratings through his own performance since his time as Mayor of Seongnam, and he maintained high ratings even in his first year in office." He added, "Typically, a drop in approval ratings starts with the less loyal peripheral supporters. But now, without any particular incident, the core support base is wavering—an unfamiliar scene is unfolding." (김씨는 이날 자신의 유튜브 방송에서 “이 대통령은 성남시장 시절부터 스스로 성과를 내 지지율을 끌어올린 정치인이고, 임기 1년 차에도 높은 지지율을 만들었다”고 했다. 그는 그러면서 “통상적인 지지율 하락은 충성도가 낮은 외곽 지지층부터 빠지는 법인데, 지금은 특별한 사건이 없음에도 코어 지지층이 흔들리는 생소한 풍경이 펼쳐지고 있다”고 했다.)

Kim noted, "Former President Roh Moo-hyun also struggled throughout his term as his core support base collapsed," and stressed, "This isn't something that can be resolved simply by showing results." He also warned, "The 'decoupling' signal where presidential approval ratings and party approval ratings diverge is very dangerous." (김씨는 “과거 노무현 전 대통령도 코어 지지층이 무너지며 임기 내내 힘들었다”며 “이는 단순히 성과를 보여준다고 해결되는 게 아니다”라고 했다. 또 “대통령 지지율과 정당 지지율이 분리되는 ‘디커플링’ 신호는 매우 위험하다”고도 했다.)

In a broadcast on the 23rd, Kim had said, "This is the first crisis since the launch of the Lee Jae-myung administration. The first major crisis of the Moon Jae-in administration was the 'Chosun Kuk' scandal, and the scale of this drop is comparable to that." He added, "On the surface, there's nothing special, but it's plummeted. The core support base is leaving." (김씨는 지난 23일 방송에서도 “이재명 정부 출범 이후 첫 번째 위기다. 문재인 정부의 첫 번째 큰 위기는 조국 사태였는데 낙폭은 거기에 비견될 정도로 크다”며 “겉으로 보면 특별한 게 없는데 훅 빠졌다. 코어 지지층이 빠진 것”이라고 했다.)

He explained, "The core support base immediately abandons those who reject their identity," and "They haven't turned their backs completely yet, but they've crossed their arms and gone 'Oh my.'" He added, "If left as is, they'll keep their arms crossed and eventually turn away." (그는 “코어 지지층은 자기 정체성을 부정하는 사람들을 바로 버린다”며 “코어 지지층이 등까지는 안 돌렸는데 ‘어머’ 하고 팔짱을 껴버린 것”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “이걸 두면 팔짱을 끼고 있다가 등을 돌린다는 것”이라고 했다.)
